title: Linearity testing of Boolean functions

problem.name: Linearity testing of Boolean functions
problem.statement_latex: Given a coherent oracle for $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$, distinguish linear functions $f(x)=a\cdot x$ from functions at normalized Hamming distance at least $\varepsilon$ from every linear function.
problem.statement_text: Given a coherent oracle for $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$, distinguish linear functions $f(x)=a\cdot x$ from functions at normalized Hamming distance at least $\varepsilon$ from every linear function.
